name: Live World Cup Score Tracker

on:
  schedule:
    # Runs automatically every 5 minutes, 24/7
    - cron: '*/5 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch: # Allows you to manually trigger it with a button click on GitHub

jobs:
  sync-scores:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Initialize Python Environment
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install Data Connectors
        run: pip install requests

      - name: Fetch Live Data Streams
        env:
          API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WORLD_CUP_API_KEY }}
        run: python fetch_live_scores.py

      - name: Commit and Push Changes Live to Dashboard
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add worldcup.json
          git diff --quiet && git diff --staged --quiet || (git commit -m "🤖 Auto-update live World Cup scores [skip ci]" && git push)
